snippet.title: Danganronpa Split Trailer
snippet.description:
Danganronpa split is a 3 chapter series that involves 10 students in the newest killing game with their Headmaster Akiokuma. This killing game is ment to be the most high stake game with 2 motives per. chapter and only a week time gap for each killing or else all the students are punished for "not participating in class". Their headmaster Akiokuma has multiple personalities and often goes from sweet and caring to morbid and rude.

Coming 2019
